coverage.method: All 165 assigned physical PDF pages reviewed as normalized OCR, with named-passage inventory cross-check. Brief paraphrases only. Page arrays are supporting occurrences, not guaranteed exhaustive occurrence indexes.
coverage.scope_note: People and organizations retained, including peripheral historical/editorial names and venues. Products and algorithms usually omitted unless useful as a research community. Broad pupil/group labels are not converted into doctoral supervision. Proposed appointments and investments are not treated as completed.
